title: Does Overnight News Explain Overnight Returns?
one_line: In S&P 500 stocks (2000-2022) overnight returns exceed intraday by ~2.75 bps/day (~7%/yr); news topics explain much of it — removing the stocks the news model selects makes the gap small and insignificant, out of sample 2011-2022.

findings.statement: Without the news-selected stocks the gap is small and insignificant (out of sample 2011-2022).

why.pattern: Information arrival: news released outside trading hours drives the overnight premium.

reported_results.headline: News explains much of the overnight-intraday gap.

tradable_edge: No index-futures strategy; supports the information-flow WHY behind the overnight specs (vs the inventory WHY).
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 2), not by the weekly pipeline.
